overview_description.description:
Paytm is a payment gateway that provides payment services to merchants and allow consumers to make seamless mobile payments from cards, bank accounts, and digital credit among others. The company maintains an open culture where everyone is a hands-on contributor and feels comfortable sharing ideas and opinions.

Founded on 2010, Paytm is owned by one of India’s mobile-internet firms, One97 Communications. Its investors include SoftBank, SAIF Partners, Alibaba Group, and Ant Financial.

about_short_description.short_description: Paytm is a digital payments start-up that offers innovative and intuitive digital products and services for customers and merchants.

product.name: Paytm UPI and Money Transfer
product.description: A digital payments service that enables users to send and receive money directly from linked bank accounts and pay online or at stores using UPI.

product.name: Paytm for Business
product.description: A merchant payments platform providing tools to accept, manage, and reconcile digital payments through QR codes, UPI, cards, payment links, and point-of-sale devices.

product.name: Paytm Recharge and Bill Payments
product.description: A consumer service for mobile, DTH, FASTag, metro, broadband, utility, insurance, loan, municipal, and other recurring bill payments.

product.name: Paytm Travel
product.description: An online travel booking service for domestic and international flights, trains, and buses, with search, schedule, seat, reservation, and cancellation features.

product.name: Paytm Money
product.description: An investment platform for stocks, mutual funds, exchange-traded products, derivatives, IPOs, ETFs, and retirement products such as NPS.

product.name: Paytm Loans and Credit
product.description: A financial services marketplace offering personal loans, merchant and business loans, credit cards, Paytm Postpaid, credit reports, and loans secured against gold or mutual funds.
